title: Strict quotient completion units commute with normalized scalar restriction
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $d$ an adic coefficient datum with ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For a scheme $T$, use its published small pro-etale ring sheaves $A_T$ and $\underline A_T$, scalar restriction $r_T$, strict derived quotient reductions $\mathcal R_T^a,\mathcal R_T^0$, derived inverse limits $\mathcal L_T^a,\mathcal L_T^0$, and actual quotient completion units $c^a,c^0$ [lem-weil-pbc-strict-quotient-scalar-balancing, lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Let $B$ be normalized strict scalar balancing, with natural components $\rho_{T,L}:r_T(\mathcal R_T^aL)\cong\mathcal R_T^0(r_TL)$ (where restriction on strict towers is understood). Let $\lambda_Z:r_T(\mathcal L_T^aZ)\cong\mathcal L_T^0(r_TZ)$ be a natural isomorphism which, on every complex of strict towers, computes by the ordinary compatible-family limit comparison followed by the specified universal right-derived comparison maps. Then for every ambient unbounded derived $A_T$-object $L$ one has $r_T(c_L^a)\lambda_{\mathcal R_T^aL}\mathcal L_T^0(\rho_{T,L})=c_{r_TL}^0$, with composition written in execution order. No completeness assumption on $L$ is required.

lean.statement:
theorem strictScalarCompletionUnit (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (B : Balancing d)
    (T : Scheme.{u})
    (lambda : rlim (ring T d true) ⋙ dres (scalar T d) ≅
      tdres (scalar T d) ⋙ rlim (ring T d false))
    (hlambda : ∀ P : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Mod (ring T d true)) ℤ,
      (dres (scalar T d)).map ((limitComparison (ring T d true)).app P) ≫
          lambda.hom.app ((TQ (ring T d true)).obj P) =
        (resFactors (scalar T d)).inv.app ((ordinaryLimit (ring T d true)).obj P) ≫
          (Q (ring T d false)).map ((limitRestriction (scalar T d)).hom.app P) ≫
          (limitComparison (ring T d false)).app
            (((tres (scalar T d)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          (rlim (ring T d false)).map ((tresFactors (scalar T d)).hom.app P))
    (L : D (ring T d true)) :
    (dres (scalar T d)).map ((completionUnit (topology T) A d.ideal true).app L) ≫
        lambda.hom.app ((reduction T d true).obj L) ≫
          (rlim (ring T d false)).map ((B.ρ T).hom.app L) =
      (completionUnit (topology T) A d.ideal false).app ((dres (scalar T d)).obj L)
